name: Beatrice Chestnut, PhD
reason: Too thin: her own site (beatricechestnut.com) offers only Enneagram leadership coaching for organisations, speaking via an agency, and articles; it lists no courses or classes of her own and links no YouTube channel. The Chestnut Paes Enneagram Academy she co-founded (cpenneagram.com) says she and Uranio Paes are ending their partnership and it will run no retreats or workshops after 2026 (its last ones are professional trainings for practitioners). Her books (The Complete Enneagram, The Enneagram Guide to Waking Up) could not be confirmed because Open Library refused our connections during this run. Her site does mention a past Shift Network course (posts/shadow). Possible re-run if she launches new offerings of her own.
